info.title: InPost Von Halsky API
info.description:
Welcome to the InPost Von Halsky API documentation.
This API serves as a powerful intermediary between merchants and InPost Von Halsky shopping
platform, enabling seamless integration and management of e-commerce operations.

API is specifically designed to be used by integration platforms, which are next used
by sellers. Within API you will be able to create Offer and publish it on InPost Von Halsky
Platform.

## Authentication
Access to API operations is restricted only for known integrators. For gathering
access token please refer to agreement policy manager.

## Language support
API by default provides messages and content in English (`en`) language.
You can manipulate this behavior by providing `Accept-Language` HTTP Header.

For incoming data which are lang-specific there are mostly defined separate
lang-related fields, which needs to be used for pass valid request.

## Key features
### Category Management
* List all available Categories within platform.
* Retrieve detailed information about specific Category and its Attributes.

### Offer Management
* Create (match) product Offers to showcase within platform.
* Update existing Offers to reflect changes in pricing or stock availability.
* Close or reopen Offers that are no longer available or relevant.

### Order Management
* List all Orders received through platform.
* Retrieve detailed information about individual Order.
* Pass invoices or shipments information to Order.

## References
Please also read our Integration Guidelines which is separate document, it
describes common scenarios using this API.

## Versioning and maintenance policy
Each API operation (endpoint) is versioned with specific `/v<version>` path prefix,
for e.g.: `/v1/categories`, which increases only on breaking changes.

To familiarize yourself with the maintenance policy and details of the versioning rules, go to the API Portal,
Versioning and Maintenance section.

`value` must be greater than 0.

delete.description:

get.summary: Lists current Offer declarations of an Organization
get.description:
Lists current offer declarations of an organization.

Returns the current declaration per Offer, paginated by Offer. Only Offers with a declaration are returned.

**Required scope(s):** `api:offers:read`.

post.summary: Sets price program declarations for a batch of Offers
post.description:
Declares participation (opt-in / opt-out) for a batch of Offers in the InPost Attractive Prices program.
Declarations apply program-wide and remain in effect going forward.
Records are immutable: each accepted Command creates a new declaration record with a new `declarationId`.

Processing is asynchronous. The response contains one Command per Offer; check the status of an individual
Command via `GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/campaigns/commands/{commandId}`.

**Required scope(s):** `api:offers:write`.

requestBody.description: Batch of Offer participation declarations (opt-in/opt-out) to set.

get.summary: Returns the current declarations for an Offer
get.description:
Returns the current declarations for an offer.

Returns the current declaration of the Offer's participation in the price program. The `declaration` field is
absent when the Offer has no declaration.

**Required scope(s):** `api:offers:read`.

Allows to check price program declaration Command status and its details.

**Required scope(s):** `api:offers:read`.

Lists price campaigns available for declarations. Returns campaign `id`, `name` and `description`.

The `id` returned here must be used as `campaignId` in every campaign-level request.

**Required scope(s):** `api:offers:read`.

post.summary: Sets campaign discount declarations for a batch of Offers
post.description:
Declares the discount percentage for a batch of Offers in specific price campaigns.
Each item contains `offerId`, `campaignId` and `discountPercentage`. `campaignId` is mandatory and must be an `id`
returned by `GET /v1/campaigns`. The declaration always means participation in the campaign.
Records are immutable: each accepted Command creates a new declaration record with a new `declarationId`.

Processing is asynchronous. The response contains one Command per item; check the status of an individual
Command via `GET /v1/organizations/{organizationId}/campaigns/commands/{commandId}`.

**Required scope(s):** `api:offers:write`.

requestBody.description: Batch of campaign discount declarations to set.

get.description:
Lists Orders for specific context.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

Retrieve comprehensive details about an Order, including purchased Offers,
customer data, Order status, payment information, shipping and billing details.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

post.description:
Marks Order as Accepted - seller accepts to handle this Order.

Paid orders are accepted automatically by the system, so calling this endpoint is not required.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.

Refuse and marks Order as refused, so it won't be processed by seller.

get.description:
Allows to check Order Command status and its details.

Lists all Delivery Methods.

Retrieve detailed information about a specific return.

post.description:
Marks the return as accepted only. Does **not** create the refund — a separate refund call is required to pay the customer.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.
**Migration note:** Deprecated. Use `/v2/organizations/{organizationId}/returns/{returnId}/accept`, which accepts the return and creates the refund in one operation.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.
**Migration note:** Deprecated. Use `/v2/organizations/{organizationId}/returns/{returnId}/reject` with `rejectReasonId`.

get.description:
Retrieve all returns associated with a specific order.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

post.description:
Refunds the customer for this order. Independent of a return or claim. Do not use for new integrations.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.
**Migration note:** Deprecated. Use `POST /v2/organizations/{organizationId}/orders/{orderId}/refund`.

requestBody.description: Amount which needs to be refunded. If request body is not provided then the whole Order is refunded.

get.description:
Retrieve a list of claims for a specific organization with optional filtering parameters.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.
**Migration note:** Deprecated. Use `GET /v2/organizations/{organizationId}/claims`.

Retrieve detailed information about a specific claim using its unique identifier.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.
**Migration note:** Deprecated. Use `GET /v2/organizations/{organizationId}/orders/{orderId}/claims/{claimId}`.

post.description:
Rejects the claim. Optional free-text comment only — no structured `rejectReasonId`. One-shot. Do not use for new integrations.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.
**Migration note:** Deprecated. Use `POST /v2/organizations/{organizationId}/claims/{claimId}/reject` with `rejectReasonId`.

Legacy partial claim refund using the amount from the original claim — the caller does not send a new amount. One-shot. Do not use for new integrations.
**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.
**Migration note:** Deprecated. Use `POST /v2/organizations/{organizationId}/claims/{claimId}/accept` with `refundAmount`.

Legacy full claim refund using the amount from the original claim — the caller does not send a new amount. One-shot. Do not use for new integrations.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.
**Migration note:** Deprecated. Use `POST /v2/organizations/{organizationId}/claims/{claimId}/accept` with `refundAmount`.

get.description:
Retrieve a list of available claim types with localized descriptions.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.
**Migration note:** Deprecated. Use `GET /v2/dictionaries/claim-types`.

Retrieve a list of claims for a specific organization with optional filtering parameters. Read-only.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

Retrieve detailed information about a specific claim using its unique identifier, including signed download URLs for its attachments. Read-only.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

post.summary: Accept a non-financial claim (no refund involved)
post.description:
Accepts a non-financial claim, i.e. one whose `specification.requestedResolution` is `REPAIR` or `REPLACEMENT`. No refund is created.
Do not use it for `REFUND` or `PARTIAL_REFUND` claims; accept those with `POST /v2/organizations/{organizationId}/claims/{claimId}/accept`.
One-shot: claim state becomes `APPROVED` and cannot be resolved again.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.

Accepts the claim and starts a refund. Send `refundAmount` (and optional shipping) at accept time — replaces both v1 full and partial claim refunds.
One-shot: a claim can be resolved only once. Claim state becomes `APPROVED`; response includes `refundId`.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.

Rejects the claim. Required `rejectReasonId` from `GET /v2/dictionaries/claim-reject-reasons`; `rejectReasonDescription` is optional.
One-shot: claim state becomes `REJECTED` and cannot be resolved again.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.

get.description:
Paged, filterable, sortable list of refund cases (settlement / monitoring). Read-only.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

post.description:
Creates a goodwill or price-correction refund, not tied to a return or claim.
Each item requires `productId`, `quantity`, `refundAmount`, and `refundReasonId` from `GET /v2/dictionaries/refund-reasons`.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.

Refunds the customer for this order. Independent of a return or claim.
Amount plus already refunded must not exceed the paid order value. Omit the body for a full refund.
Does not accept a goods return.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.

requestBody.description: Amount which needs to be refunded. If request body is not provided then the whole Order is refunded.

get.summary: Get detailed information about a specific refund
get.description:
Single refund case: status, amounts, products and reason. If payment failed for a known reason, that reason is returned in business form. Read-only.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

get.summary: Calculate refund amount for a specific refund
get.description:
Read-only product vs shipping split for this refund as of now. Shipping eligibility can change over time; this call does not create or modify the refund.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

post.summary: Retry a rejected payment for a refund
post.description:
Retries a previously rejected or failed payment for a refund belonging to the organization.
Accepted for asynchronous processing.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.

get.description:
Paged list of organization returns, optional status filter. Each item includes returned products. Read-only.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

Single return: amounts, linked refund payment status, tracking, reject reason when rejected, localized products. Read-only; typically used before accept or reject.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

post.description:
Accepts the return and creates the customer refund in the same call.
Required `refundAmount` must be positive and must not exceed the order total.
Return becomes `ACCEPTED`; refund is stored with payment status `NEW`.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.

Rejects the return. Required `rejectReasonId` must be a current entry from `GET /v2/dictionaries/return-reject-reasons` (unknown ids are rejected).
Return becomes `REJECTED`; the reason is stored; the customer is notified.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:write`.

get.description:
Returns for one order, optional status filter and paging. Read-only.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

Claim-type codes and labels for customer claim filing.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

Refund reasons for per-line `refundReasonId` on independent refund create. Labels follow `Accept-Language` (pl / en, default Polish). Refresh periodically.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

Return-reject reasons for `rejectReasonId` on v2 return reject. Labels follow `Accept-Language` (pl / en, default Polish). Refresh periodically.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

Claim-reject reasons for `rejectReasonId` on v2 claim reject. Labels follow `Accept-Language` (pl / en, default Polish). Refresh periodically.

**Required scope(s):** `api:orders:read`.

errorMessage.example: The requested resource was not found.

CategoryName.description: Category name translated for requested locale (Accept-Language).

CategoryDescription.example: Health products and all products related to healthy life.

Category.description:
Simple representation of Category into which Offer must be assigned to.
Projects as simple item in Category Tree which contains only minimal data like
name of category, its eventual children and is it leaf or not.

For more detailed objects see usages of `CategoryDetailed` schema.

MapEntry.description: Map entry with string-key and string-value.

CategoryRelationType.description:
Category type relation - one category with other category.
* `MAIN_PARENT`           Should occur only once in relations collection.

Possible future values:
* `ALT_PARENT`            Parent Cross-category, may be used multiple times.
* `SIMILAR`               Similar category.
* `SIBLING`
* `SUGGESTED`             Suggested category to be used, in case first chose
                          is deprecated or generally not recommended to be used.
* `CHILD`

CategoryRelationTuple.description: Describes relation between this Category and other Category.

CategoryDetailed.description:
Detailed representation of Category into which Offer must be assigned to.
Comparing to simple object (`Category` schema) it contains additionally relations
details and meta-information about Category.

For less detailed objects see usages of `Category` schema.

AttributeType.description:
What kind of Attribute this is and what kind of value type is expected to be
  sent by consumer to fill specific Attribute:
  * `TEXT_VALUE`      Open, one like text value that might be provided by consumer.
  * `LONG_TEXT_VALUE` Long text value, multiline to be provided by seller eg. Guarantee policy of product.
  * `DICTIONARY`      Value which should/must be provided from delivered `allowedValues` set.
                      Policy of choices (none, one, multiple) can be adjusted with `expectedValue`.
  * `NUMERIC`         Numeric value, eg. weight of product in [kg]s: 10. No floating.
  * `NUMERIC_FLOAT`   Floating numeric value, eg. weight of product in [kg]s: 10,23.
  * `DATE`            Date value without time, eg. date when book was published.
  * `URL`             URL to some resource, eg. url to product manual.

Lang.description:
Language code of mix ISO 639 and ISO 3166. It's also possible in some circumstances
that Country is marked as wildcard if its value doesn't matter, eg.: `en_*` or just `en`.

It's also possible to pass `null`, if sent data are general/universal: language and country
doesn't matter (e.g. Producer name, which is might be same for all languages).

AttributeExpectedValueType.description:
Value which is expected to be sent by consumer to fill specific Attribute:
* `NULL_OR_ONE`       Null (no value) or one value is expected.
                      Treat as `required: false, nullable: true` / optional.
* `ONE`               One value is expected.
                      Treat as `required: true, nullable: false` / required.
* `AT_LEAST_ONE`      At least one value is expected.
                      Treat as `required: true, nullable: false`.
* `ANY` (default)     Null, one or multiple values are expected here. Full freedom.
                      This is similar to `NULL_OR_ONE`, but accepts also multiple values.

AttributeName.description: Attribute name translated for requested locale (Accept-Language).

AttributeDescription.description: An Attribute Definition Description translated for requested locale (Accept-Language).
AttributeDescription.example: Please provide one of defined options from dictionary if attribute's type is 'DICTIONARY'.

AttributeDictionaryName.description: Attribute Dictionary name translated for requested locale (Accept-Language).

AttributeDictionaryOption.description: One option in Dictionary, which is applicable for specified lang or any (`null`, `*`).

AttributeDictionary.description: Dictionary which is related for specific Attribute.

AttributeUnitOfMeasureDetails.description:
Details of the unit of measure in which a measurable Attribute's value (eg. weight, volume)
should be expressed. Present only on `AttributeDefinition`s which represent such a value.

code.description: Unique code of the unit of measure.

symbol.description: Symbol of the unit of measure.

group.description: Group (physical quantity) which the unit of measure belongs to, eg. mass, volume, length.

translation.description: Unit of measure name translated for requested locale (Accept-Language).

AttributeDefinition.description:
Attribute definition which describes attribute which may/must be defined for specific product
placed in that Category.
Mostly `type` field describes type of value which is expected.
If Attribute is dictionary-based then `dictionary` must be followed with allowed values.
`expectedValue` field describes how many values are expected to be sent by consumer.
If Attribute represents a measurable value (eg. weight, volume) then `unitOfMeasureDetails`
is present and describes the unit in which the value should be expressed."

limit.description: Maximum number of elements per page.

validationMessage.example: The image attached to offer is inappropriate

RejectionReasonList.description: A list of rejection reason messages.

Ean.description:
European Article Number / International Article Number. It can be assigned if not previously set.
Once assigned, its value is fixed and cannot be changed.

Dimension.description: Object representing Dimension (whl) with item/package weight.

width.description: Width of single item packaging in mm.

height.description: Height of single item packaging in mm.

length.description: Length of single item packaging in mm.

weight.description: Weight of single item packaging in g.

attributes.description: Defined Values of Attributes related to Category.

StockUnit.description: The unit in which the stock level is expressed.

Stock.description: Information about number of item in stock.

Money.description: Money - representation of amount and currency.

amount.description: Amount of money. If more decimal digits are provided than allowed, the value is rounded mathematically to two decimal places.

DepositType.description: Type of deposit for a reusable container.

DepositPosition.description: Deposit for a containers of the product.

OfferPriceTag.description: GET price of the item. Write counterpart is PriceTag.

grossPrice.description: Regular gross price of the item, excluding any active promotion.

promotionPrice.description: Discounted gross price while the offer's promotion is active. Absent when there is no promotion.

finalPrice.description: Final gross price displayed to buyers, after applying any active promotion or Attractive Price Program discount.

PromotionMode.description:
How to interpret the promotion's `value` field:
* `PERCENTAGE` - `value` is a percentage discount off the gross price (e.g. `15` means 15% off).
* `FIXED_PRICE` - `value` is the resulting promotional price.
